_note: Service intent slug -> Companies House SIC 2007 codes used to match installers to that service. [] = no installer directory for the service. A code only resolves to companies if it was pulled by scripts/fetch-installers.php (currently 43342 only). 43320 (Joinery installation - 'installation of doors, windows...') is listed for uPVC doors so the mesh splits automatically if that code is fetched later; today it resolves to nothing.
